translations.web: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
translations.bsb: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.
translations.kjv: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
